name: aura
description: A blank template to get started with Payload 3.0

scripts.production:deploy: node scripts/cf-guard.mjs production && pnpm run production:deploy:database && pnpm run production:deploy:app
scripts.production:deploy:app: node scripts/cf-guard.mjs production && opennextjs-cloudflare build && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc --profile aura-personal
scripts.production:deploy:database: node scripts/cf-guard.mjs production && cross-env NODE_ENV=production PAYLOAD_SECRET=ignore WRANGLER_CONFIG_PATH=wrangler.jsonc payload migrate && wrangler d1 execute D1 --config wrangler.jsonc --profile aura-personal --command 'PRAGMA optimize' --remote
scripts.devsafe: powershell -Command "Remove-Item -Recurse -Force .next,.open-next -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue" && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation next dev
scripts.generate:types: pnpm run generate:types:cloudflare && pnpm run generate:types:payload
scripts.staging:sevenseas:deploy: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS="--no-deprecation --max-old-space-size=8000" NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL=https://aura-dynamics-staging.seasseven123.workers.dev opennextjs-cloudflare build -c wrangler.sevenseas-staging.jsonc && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.sevenseas-staging.jsonc --profile default
scripts.staging:aura:migrate: node scripts/cf-guard.mjs staging && cross-env NODE_ENV=production WRANGLER_CONFIG_PATH=wrangler.aura-staging.jsonc payload migrate
scripts.staging:aura:dry-run: node scripts/cf-guard.mjs staging && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.aura-staging.jsonc --profile aura-official --dry-run
scripts.staging:aura:deploy: node scripts/cf-guard.mjs staging && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS="--no-deprecation --max-old-space-size=8000" NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL=https://staging.printwithaura.com NEXT_PUBLIC_NOINDEX=true opennextjs-cloudflare build -c wrangler.aura-staging.jsonc && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.aura-staging.jsonc --profile aura-official
scripts.test: pnpm run test:int && pnpm run test:e2e

PAYLOAD_SECRET.description: Generate a random string using `openssl rand -hex 32`
